approachSection.headline: Four stages. No surprises.
approachSection.subdescription: Every engagement runs the same way, so you always know what is happening and what comes next.

steps.title: Discover
steps.description: We map the problem space, talk to the people who use the product, and audit what already exists.

steps.title: Define
steps.description: Findings become a product direction — scoped, prioritised, and agreed before anyone opens Figma.

steps.title: Design
steps.description: Flows, interfaces and a design system built so the work survives handoff instead of drifting.

steps.title: Deliver
steps.description: We stay through build. What ships is what was designed, not an approximation of it.
